name: vigioni
description: Fundação do SaaS multi-tenant de monitoramento VigiOn

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @vigioni/api" "npm run dev -w @vigioni/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vigioni/shared && npm run build -w @vigioni/api && npm run build -w @vigioni/web && npm run build -w @vigioni/gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vigioni/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vigioni/api && npm run typecheck -w @vigioni/web && npm run typecheck -w @vigioni/gateway
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vigioni/api && npm run test -w @vigioni/gateway && npm run test -w @vigioni/web && npm run test:importer
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/assert-test-database.mjs && prisma migrate deploy && npm test
